question: Can a frozen budgeted matcher expose quality-preserving placement actions from the 58 arrangements, within an absolute recognition budget, without using future outcomes to choose where to look?
budget_rule: absolute per-box limit = floor(cheap_fraction * mean primitive effort on the development manifests). Eval boxes do not enter that mean.
evaluation_gate: mean recognition cost / mean primitive effort on validation fresh < 0.10
anchors: If the board is empty, the only anchor is [0, 0]. Otherwise the first 4 free cells in row-major order that touch an occupied cell. The scan stops when that many anchors are found.
recall: A hit is the same pattern and the same origin as a sampled reference action that preserves quality and saves at least min_saving. Another placement of the same pattern is not a hit. The reference is not an exhaustive list of useful actions.

decision_rows.retains_opportunities: cheap on validation fresh, and the sampled reference opportunities are recalled and retained
decision_rows.misses_opportunities: cheap, but recall or retention is below the floor; diagnose anchor coverage before changing the library
decision_rows.recognition_expensive: validation-fresh recognition cost is not under 0.10 of primitive effort; stop this access design

not_this_experiment: No commitment policy. No learned embedding. No claim of cheaper autonomous solving. Rejected consultations are not yet repaid because nothing is committed.
